name: Lysergic acid 2-butyl amide
summary: Lysergic acid 2-butylamide (LSB or LASBA), also known as 2-butyllysergamide, is an analogue of LSD originally developed by Richard Pioch at Eli Lilly in the 1950s, but mostly publicised through research conducted by the team led by David E. Nichols at Purdue University.

pharmacology.text: The corresponding (R)-2-pentyl analogue has higher binding affinity for the 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors, but is less potent in producing drug-appropriate responding, suggesting that the butyl compound has a higher efficacy at the receptor target.

uses.text: Lysergic acid 2-butylamide (LSB or LASBA), also known as 2-butyllysergamide, is an analogue of LSD originally developed by Richard Pioch at Eli Lilly in the 1950s, but mostly publicised through research conducted by the team led by David E. Nichols at Purdue University.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. Psychedelic lysergamides such as LSD can cause anxiety, confusion, paranoia, nausea, a faster heart rate and dilated pupils, and may trigger psychosis in people prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。LSD 等迷幻類麥角醯胺可能引起焦慮、混亂、偏執、噁心、心跳加快與瞳孔放大，也可能誘發易感者的精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。LSD 等迷幻类麦角酰胺可能引起焦虑、混乱、偏执、恶心、心跳加快与瞳孔放大，也可能诱发易感者的精神病。

fact.en: It is a structural isomer of LSD: both share the formula C20H25N3O, but the two ethyl groups of LSD are rearranged into a single 2-butyl group.
fact.zh: 它是 LSD 的結構異構物：兩者的分子式都是 C20H25N3O，只是 LSD 的兩個乙基被重新排列成單一個2-丁基。
fact.zhHans: 它是 LSD 的结构异构物：两者的分子式都是 C20H25N3O，只是 LSD 的两个乙基被重新排列成单一个2-丁基。
